# Tier B power budget (generated by `tools/power_budget.py`)

**Battery:** 1S2P LiFePO4 18650, 3000 mAh nominal, 90% usable = **2700 mAh** at 3.2 V.
**Requirement P2:** ≥7 days without sun. All figures are mAh/day at the battery (converter losses included:
η = 0.85 for active loads, 0.6 for the µA-level floor).

## Modes (firmware `power_policy`)
### NORMAL: SEN66 + Wi-Fi every 5 min
| Item | mAh/day |
|---|---|
| Sleep floor | 2.5 |
| 60 s wakes (CO + BME688 + detection) | 8.6 |
| SEN66 samples | 305.7 |
| Wi-Fi uplinks | 32.0 |
| **Total** | **349** |

### SAVER: after 24 h without charging, or SoC < 40 %: every 15 min
| Item | mAh/day |
|---|---|
| Sleep floor | 2.5 |
| 60 s wakes (CO + BME688 + detection) | 8.6 |
| SEN66 samples | 101.9 |
| Wi-Fi uplinks | 10.7 |
| **Total** | **124** |

### SAVER on a smoke day: plus 6 h of detector bursts
| Item | mAh/day |
|---|---|
| Sleep floor | 2.5 |
| 60 s wakes (CO + BME688 + detection) | 8.6 |
| SEN66 samples | 101.9 |
| Wi-Fi uplinks | 10.7 |
| Smoke-event bursts (6 h/day) | 115.9 |
| **Total** | **240** |

### CRITICAL: SoC < 10 %: SEN66 off, hourly uplink, CO + BME688 keep running
| Item | mAh/day |
|---|---|
| Sleep floor | 2.5 |
| 60 s wakes (CO + BME688 + detection) | 8.6 |
| SEN66 samples | 0.0 |
| Wi-Fi uplinks | 2.7 |
| **Total** | **14** |

## Seven days without sun
| Scenario | 7-day use | Margin | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| NORMAL all week (no policy) | 2443 mAh | +257 mAh | 7.7 days ✅ |
| Policy: NORMAL day 1, SAVER after | 1092 mAh | +1608 mAh | 20.0 days ✅ |
| Policy + smoke every day (6 h bursts) | 1787 mAh | +913 mAh | ✅ |
| Same, cells at 0 °C (~85 % capacity) | 1787 mAh | +508 mAh | ✅ |

Smoke reduces sunlight, so "no sun" and "smoke event" are likely to coincide: the third row is the design case.
Below −10 °C the SEN66 is parked (datasheet limit), so winter runs close to CRITICAL (~14 mAh/day).

## Radio comparison
LoRaWAN uplinks are cheaper than Wi-Fi (no association or TLS handshake): every 5 min ≈ 4.4 mAh/day
vs 32.0 mAh/day for Wi-Fi. Wi-Fi stays primary because it carries the full JSON and OTA;
if pilot gateways exist, a "LoRa-first" firmware setting would save ~28 mAh/day.

## Solar
2 W panel × peak-sun-hours × ~0.55 system efficiency (panel angle/temperature, MPPSET 4.44 V below Vmp, charger):
| Month (ON/BC pilots) | Peak sun h | Harvest mAh/day | vs NORMAL (349) |
|---|---|---|---|
| July | 5.5 | 1891 | surplus |
| October | 2.5 | 859 | surplus |
| December | 1.3 | 447 | surplus |
Peak-sun hours are rough Canadian averages (est.): replace with the pilot site's NRCan photovoltaic map value.

## Assumptions to measure at bring-up
- 60 s wake: ESP32 0.4 s @ 40 mA (est.) + BME688 heater 150 ms @ 12 mA (datasheet)
- SEN66 sample: 35 s @ 90 mA (30 s PM start-up + 5 s readings; datasheet 90 mA typ)
- Wi-Fi MQTT/TLS uplink: 3 s @ 110 mA avg incl. TX peaks ~300 mA (est.; measure)
- LoRaWAN uplink 11 B at SF10: 0.37 s TX @ 120 mA + RX windows (RAK3172 datasheet)
- Sleep floor: measure VBAT current with JP1 cut and a µA meter across it (target ≤ 100 µA).
